# Support runbook: BC Atlas Warehouse Example

## Process an existing warehouse request from the request list

Guide: [Process an existing warehouse request from the request list](./warehouse-request-process.md)

### What to monitor

- Requests that stay unprocessed for more than a day in the Warehouse Requests list.

### How to recover

- Open the request again and choose Process; processing a request twice changes nothing.

### Troubleshooting

- Process is not available: the user lacks the WAREHOUSE PROCESS permission set.
